description.value: Burrito Grill is a Mexican-inspired restaurant in Kimberley, BC, serving award-winning fresh burritos, tacos, quesadillas, soups, and nachos made with daily-prepared tortilla chips and house salsas. The restaurant has been catering events across the Columbia Valley for over 10 years and can host groups of up to 75 people when its two patios are open. It recently completed a renovation and held a Grand Reopening in May 2026, offering dine-in, takeout, delivery, and full-scale event catering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and confirms the business is real, open, and operating in Kimberley, BC at 160 Howard St. A Grand Reopening was held May 23rd 2026 after a renovation (May 6–16), so the business is open as of today (May 29, 2026). Website explicitly confirms takeout and delivery, gluten-free and vegan options, wheelchair-accessible entrance, and accessible washrooms with a baby-changing station; no mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging.
concerns: Website spells the city name as 'Kimberely' (typo) on the contact page; correct spelling is 'Kimberley'.
OSM record has no address or phone number — both are confirmed only via the website (160 Howard St, 250-427-0502).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in Kimberley with a confirmed address, active website, and recent Grand Reopening after renovation. Clearly a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The dog-friendly sidewalk patio and two warm-weather patios may offer informal bike visibility for cyclists eating outside, but no bike rack or designated bike parking is mentioned on the website.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'Offering Gluten-Free & Vegan Options'; catering page notes menus can be made 'entirely gluten-free, nut-free, vegetarian, or vegan'; menu includes dedicated vegan/vegetarian items such as The Gatherer burrito

wow_evidence: award-winning fresh burritos ... catering events across the Columbia Valley for over 10 years

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: Burrito/taco place positioned as 'fairly priced, much lower than competitors'
